## Delimiter: ","
## chr   (4): Round, Venue, Opponent, Result
## dbl  (11): GF, GA, Goals, Shots, SoT, SoT_pct, G_per_Sh, G_per_SoT, PK, PKat...
## date  (1): Date

## Rows: 17 Columns: 8
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr  (4): Round, Venue, Opponent, Result
## dbl  (3): GF, GA, Assists
## date (1): Date
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
# Stage ordering — used across all plots
stage_levels <- c("League phase", "Knockout play-offs",
                  "Round of 16", "Quarter-finals", "Semi-finals", "Final")
 
# Group rounds into "League" vs "Knockout" for cleaner comparisons
add_phase <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Round    = factor(Round, levels = stage_levels),
      Stage    = ifelse(Round == "League phase", "League Phase", "Knockout"),
      Stage    = factor(Stage, levels = c("League Phase", "Knockout")),
      Won      = str_detect(Result, "^W"),
      match_no = row_number()
    )
}
 
m26 <- add_phase(m26)
m25 <- add_phase(m25)

Loading Libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)

Analysis 1

# ANALYSIS 1 — THE CORE STORY: POSSESSION DROPS AS STAKES RISE (2025-26)
# =============================================================================
 
p_poss <- m26 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = match_no, y = Possession)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
  geom_line(color = psg_red, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Won), size = 3.5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Opponent), size = 2.8, color = "grey30",
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = psg_blue, `FALSE` = "grey60"),
                     labels = c("Not won", "Won")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = m26$match_no, labels = m26$Round,
                     guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1), limits = c(30, 85)) +
  labs(
    title = "PSG Possession Falls as the Knockouts Deepen (2025-26 UCL)",
    subtitle = "Winning big games with less of the ball: 35% vs Bayern in the semi",
    x = NULL, y = "Possession %", color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"),
        legend.position = "top")
 
print(p_poss)

# League vs Knockout possession averages
m26 %>%
  group_by(Stage) %>%
  summarise(avg_poss = mean(Possession), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   Stage        avg_poss
##   <fct>           <dbl>
## 1 League Phase     67.9
## 2 Knockout         58
# =============================================================================

Analysis 2

# ANALYSIS 2 — SHOOTING EFFICIENCY: FEWER SHOTS, MORE CLINICAL IN KNOCKOUTS
# =============================================================================
 
p_eff <- m26 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Shots, y = SoT_pct, color = Stage, size = Goals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Opponent), size = 2.7, color = "grey30",
                  show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("League Phase" = "grey55", "Knockout" = psg_red)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Shot Volume vs Accuracy (2025-26 UCL)",
    subtitle = "Knockout games: fewer shots, higher on-target % (Chelsea R16 = 88.9%)\nBubble size = goals scored",
    x = "Total Shots", y = "Shots on Target %",
    color = "Stage", size = "Goals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
 
print(p_eff)

# Efficiency summary by stage
m26 %>%
  group_by(Stage) %>%
  summarise(
    matches      = n(),
    avg_shots    = mean(Shots),
    avg_sot_pct  = mean(SoT_pct),
    avg_g_per_sh = mean(G_per_Sh),
    goals        = sum(Goals),

  ) %>%
  print()

Analysis 3

# ANALYSIS 3 — GOALS vs EXPECTED OUTPUT (conversion proxy via G/Sh)
# =============================================================================
# No xG in this dataset, but G/Sh and SoT% let us see finishing quality
 
p_finishing <- m26 %>%
  mutate(expected_from_shots = Shots * mean(G_per_Sh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = expected_from_shots, y = Goals, color = Stage)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Opponent), size = 2.7, color = "grey30",
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("League Phase" = "grey55", "Knockout" = psg_red)) +
  labs(
    title = "Finishing: Actual Goals vs Shot-Volume Expectation",
    subtitle = "Above the line = clinical overperformance (Chelsea, Leverkusen, Bayern SF)",
    x = "Goals Expected from Shot Volume", y = "Actual Goals", color = "Stage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
 
print(p_finishing)

Analysis 4

# ANALYSIS 4 — CROSS-SEASON: GOALS PER MATCH BY STAGE (24-25 vs 25-26)
# =============================================================================
 
cross <- bind_rows(
  m25 %>% transmute(Season = "2024-25", Round, Stage, GF, GA, Won),
  m26 %>% transmute(Season = "2025-26", Round, Stage, GF, GA, Won)
)
 
p_cross <- cross %>%
  group_by(Season, Stage) %>%
  summarise(gf = mean(GF), ga = mean(GA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(gf, ga), names_to = "type", values_to = "val") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type, gf = "Goals For", ga = "Goals Against")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Stage, y = val, fill = Season)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(val, 1)),
            position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2024-25" = psg_blue, "2025-26" = psg_red)) +
  facet_wrap(~ type) +
  labs(
    title = "Goals per Match: League Phase vs Knockouts",
    subtitle = "Comparing the title run (24-25) with the current campaign (25-26)",
    x = NULL, y = "Avg Goals per Match", fill = "Season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
 
print(p_cross)

Analysis 5

# ANALYSIS 5 — SIMPLE PLAYSTYLE CLUSTERING (2025-26, k-means)
# =============================================================================
# Group matches into tactical archetypes using possession + shooting profile
 
set.seed(42)
 
clust_vars <- m26 %>%
  select(Possession, Shots, SoT_pct, G_per_Sh) %>%
  scale()
 
km <- kmeans(clust_vars, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
 
m26_clustered <- m26 %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(km$cluster))
 
# Interpret clusters by their averages
cluster_profile <- m26_clustered %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    avg_poss   = round(mean(Possession), 1),
    avg_shots  = round(mean(Shots), 1),
    avg_sot    = round(mean(SoT_pct), 1),
    avg_goals  = round(mean(Goals), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
cat("\n=== Cluster Profiles (label these yourself) ===\n")
## 
## === Cluster Profiles (label these yourself) ===
print(cluster_profile)
## # A tibble: 3 × 6
##   Cluster     n avg_poss avg_shots avg_sot avg_goals
##   <fct>   <int>    <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl>     <dbl>
## 1 1           4     44.5      13.5    46.3       2.5
## 2 2          10     71.7      22.6    34.1       2.6
## 3 3           2     56         8.5    75.7       4
p_clust <- m26_clustered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Possession, y = SoT_pct, color = Cluster, size = Goals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Opponent), size = 2.7, color = "grey30",
                  show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = psg_red, "2" = psg_blue, "3" = gold)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "PSG Match Playstyle Clusters (2025-26 UCL)",
    subtitle = "Possession vs shot accuracy — 3 tactical modes",
    x = "Possession %", y = "Shots on Target %", color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
 
print(p_clust)

# INSIGHT 1 — THE ATTACKING FOCAL POINT SHIFTED (Dembélé → Kvaratskhelia)
# =============================================================================
# The single clearest cross-season story in the data.
 
focal <- players %>%
  filter(Player %in% c("Ousmane Dembele","Khvicha Kvaratskhelia",
                        "Desire Doue","Bradley Barcola","Achraf Hakimi","Vitinha")) %>%
  select(Player, Season, GplusA)
 
p1 <- focal %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = GplusA, group = Player, color = Player)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = focal %>% filter(Season == "2025-26"),
    aes(label = Player), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.05, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "PSG's Attacking Focal Point Shifted",
    subtitle = "Kvaratskhelia surged (5 → 16 G+A) as Dembélé's output/minutes dropped (14 → 9)",
    x = NULL, y = "Goals + Assists (UCL)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
print(p1)

# Insight 2

# INSIGHT 2 — IS THE ATTACK MORE COLLECTIVE? (G+A concentration)
# =============================================================================
# Flatter curve = more spread-out / collective attack
 
conc <- players %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  arrange(Season, desc(GplusA)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number(),
         cum_share = cumsum(GplusA) / sum(GplusA)) %>%
  ungroup()
 
p2 <- conc %>%
  ggplot(aes(rank, cum_share, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2024-25" = psg_blue, "2025-26" = psg_red)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(title = "How Concentrated Is PSG's Attack?",
       subtitle = "Cumulative share of team G+A by player rank — flatter = more collective",
       x = "Players (ranked by G+A)", y = "Cumulative share of G+A") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
print(p2)

# How many players to reach 50% of G+A?
conc %>% group_by(Season) %>%
  summarise(players_to_50pct = sum(cum_share < 0.5) + 1) %>% print()
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   Season  players_to_50pct
##   <chr>              <dbl>
## 1 2024-25                4
## 2 2025-26                4

Player insight 3

# INSIGHT 3 — THE PRESSING FINGERPRINT: do attackers win the ball high?
# =============================================================================
# Forwards with high defensive actions/90 = front-foot pressing signal.
# Honest caveat: no pitch zones, so this is "who wins the ball", not "where".
 
press <- players %>%
  filter(Nineties >= 4) %>%          # enough minutes to be meaningful
  mutate(Line = case_when(
    Pos == "FW" ~ "Forwards",
    Pos == "MF" ~ "Midfield",
    TRUE        ~ "Defense"))
 
p3 <- press %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = DefActions_per90, y = reorder(Player, DefActions_per90),
             color = Season)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2024-25" = psg_blue, "2025-26" = psg_red)) +
  facet_grid(Line ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Ball-Winning by Player (Interceptions + Tackles per 90)",
       x = "Defensive actions per 90", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p3)

# Forwards' average ball-winning, by season (the press intensity proxy)
press %>% filter(Line == "Forwards") %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  summarise(avg_fwd_defactions = round(mean(DefActions_per90), 2)) %>% print()

Insight 5

# INSIGHT 5 — PLAYER ROLE CLUSTERING (the squad-structure centrepiece)
# =============================================================================
# Cluster 2025-26 outfield players into roles by their statistical profile.
 
set.seed(42)
clust_df <- players %>%
  filter(Season == "2025-26", Nineties >= 4) %>%
  select(Player, Pos, GplusA, Shots, Crosses,
         Interceptions, TacklesWon, DefActions_per90)
 
X <- clust_df %>% select(-Player, -Pos) %>% scale()
km <- kmeans(X, centers =4, nstart = 25)
 
clust_df <- clust_df %>% mutate(Cluster = factor(km$cluster))
 
cat("\n=== Role cluster profiles (label them by the averages) ===\n")
## 
## === Role cluster profiles (label them by the averages) ===
clust_df %>% group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            GplusA = round(mean(GplusA),1),
            Shots  = round(mean(Shots),1),
            DefActions90 = round(mean(DefActions_per90),2),
            players = paste(Player, collapse = ", ")) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
## # A tibble: 4 × 6
##   Cluster     n GplusA Shots DefActions90
##   <fct>   <int>  <dbl> <dbl>        <dbl>
## 1 1           3    5.3  24           2.42
## 2 2           7    3.3  13.9         1.77
## 3 3           2   12.5  37           1.79
## 4 4           1    9    30           0.49
##   players                                                                       
##   <chr>                                                                         
## 1 Vitinha, Nuno Mendes, Joao Neves                                              
## 2 Willian Pacho, Warren Zaire-Emery, Marquinhos, Achraf Hakimi, Bradley Barcola…
## 3 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Desire Doue                                            
## 4 Ousmane Dembele
p5 <- clust_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = DefActions_per90, y = GplusA, color = Cluster, size = Shots)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Player), size = 2.7, color = "grey30",
                  show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = psg_red, "2" = psg_blue, "3" = gold, "4" = "#2a9d8f")) +
  labs(title = "PSG Squad Structure — Player Roles (2025-26)",
       subtitle = "Ball-winning (x) vs attacking output (y) — clusters = role groups",
       x = "Defensive actions per 90", y = "Goals + Assists") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
print(p5)

### Analysis of clusters: Cluster 3 (yellow) = The elite creators. Kvaratskhelia and Doué. Top of the chart for output, and they do moderate defensive work. Your two highest-ceiling attacking weapons. Cluster 1 (red) = The two-way engine. Vitinha, João Neves, Nuno Mendes. Furthest right on ball-winning and still producing 4-7 G+A. This is the control center of the team — they win it back and they build. Cluster 4 (teal) = The pure dagger. Just Dembélé, sitting alone. High output, almost no defensive work, far left. The algorithm literally isolated him — which makes sense: he’s a one-of-a-kind profile, the finisher who’s freed from pressing duties. Cluster 2 (blue) = The supporting cast. Hakimi, Barcola, Marquinhos, Pacho, Fabián Ruiz, Zaïre-Emery, Mayulu. Moderate everything. What the k=4 split actually reveals: The most interesting change from k=3 is that Dembélé got his own cluster. That’s not noise but confirms that his profile (high G+A, near-zero pressing) is genuinely unique in the squad. No one else plays his role. That’s a real, defensible finding for your project: PSG’s system gives exactly one player a pressing exemption, and it’s Dembélé.

m26     <- read_csv("psg_ucl_2526.csv")
## Rows: 16 Columns: 16
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr   (4): Round, Venue, Opponent, Result
## dbl  (11): GF, GA, Goals, Shots, SoT, SoT_pct, G_per_Sh, G_per_SoT, PK, PKat...
## date  (1): Date
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
#PLAYER RADAR PROFILES (2025-26)
# =============================================================================
# Five dimensions, each normalised 0-1 across the squad so shapes are comparable:
#   Finishing  = G/Sh
#   Volume     = Shots per 90
#   Creating   = Assists per 90
#   BallWinning= Defensive actions per 90
#   Crossing   = Crosses per 90
 
radar_src <- players %>%
  filter(Season == "2025-26", Nineties >= 4) %>%
  transmute(
    Player,
    Finishing   = G_per_Sh,
    Volume      = Shots / Nineties,
    Creating    = Assists / Nineties,
    BallWinning = DefActions_per90,
    Crossing    = Crosses / Nineties
  )

norm01 <- function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
radar_norm <- radar_src %>%
  mutate(across(Finishing:Crossing, norm01))

axis_levels <- c("Finishing","Volume","Creating","BallWinning","Crossing")

# Pick the players to feature
picks <- c("Ousmane Dembele","Khvicha Kvaratskhelia",
           "Joao Neves","Achraf Hakimi","Desire Doue")
radar_long <- radar_norm %>%
  filter(Player %in% picks) %>%
  pivot_longer(Finishing:Crossing, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = axis_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Player, Metric)
# ---- Radar via ggplot (polygon in polar coords) ----
# Reshape to long, close the polygon by repeating first axis
axis_levels <- c("Finishing","Volume","Creating","BallWinning","Crossing")
 
# Shorten the axis labels so they don't clip on the small facets
radar_long <- radar_long %>%
  mutate(Metric = recode(Metric,
    "BallWinning" = "Press",
    "Volume"      = "Shot Vol",
    "Finishing"   = "Finish",
    "Creating"    = "Create",
    "Crossing"    = "Cross"
  ))
# keep the axis order after renaming
radar_long$Metric <- factor(radar_long$Metric,
  levels = c("Finish","Shot Vol","Create","Press","Cross"))

p_radar <- radar_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Value, group = Player, color = Player, fill = Player)) +
  geom_polygon(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  coord_polar() +
  facet_wrap(~ Player) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Khvicha Kvaratskhelia" = psg_red,
    "Achraf Hakimi"         = gold,
    "Joao Neves"            = psg_blue,
    "Ousmane Dembele"       = "#2a9d8f",
    "Desire Doue"           = "#7b2cbf"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Khvicha Kvaratskhelia" = psg_red,
    "Achraf Hakimi"         = gold,
    "Joao Neves"            = psg_blue,
    "Ousmane Dembele"       = "#2a9d8f",
    "Desire Doue"           = "#7b2cbf"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Player Profiles — PSG 2025-26 UCL",
    subtitle = "Each axis normalised 0-1 across the squad. Shape = role fingerprint.",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 6.5),
    axis.text.y   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin   = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
  )
print(p_radar)

# ---- Alternative: single overlaid radar with fmsb (classic look) ----
# fmsb needs a specific frame: row1 = max, row2 = min, then players
library(fmsb)
fmsb_df <- radar_norm %>%
  filter(Player %in% picks) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Player") %>%
  select(all_of(axis_levels))
 
fmsb_df <- rbind(rep(1, 5), rep(0, 5), fmsb_df)  # add max/min rows
 
cols <- c(psg_red, gold, psg_blue, "#2a9d8f", "#7b2cbf")
op <- par(mar = c(1,1,2,1))
radarchart(
  fmsb_df, axistype = 1,
  pcol = cols, pfcol = scales::alpha(cols, 0.15), plwd = 2, plty = 1,
  cglcol = "grey80", cglty = 1, axislabcol = "grey50",
  caxislabels = c("0","","0.5","","1"), cglwd = 0.8, vlcex = 0.85,
  title = "PSG Player Profiles (overlaid)"
)
legend("topright", legend = rownames(fmsb_df)[-(1:2)],
       col = cols, lty = 1, lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

par(op)
 
# Print the raw (un-normalised) numbers so you can describe shapes accurately
cat("\n=== Raw per-90 profile values (for interpretation) ===\n")
## 
## === Raw per-90 profile values (for interpretation) ===
radar_src %>% filter(Player %in% picks) %>%
  mutate(across(Finishing:Crossing, ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  print()

Home vs Away Identity for 2025-26

ha <- m26 %>%
  mutate(
    GD = GF - GA,
    Venue = factor(Venue, levels = c("Home","Away"))
  )
 
# Summary table
ha_summary <- ha %>%
  group_by(Venue) %>%
  summarise(
    matches    = n(),
    avg_poss   = round(mean(Possession), 1),
    avg_shots  = round(mean(Shots), 1),
    avg_sot    = round(mean(SoT), 1),
    avg_GF     = round(mean(GF), 1),
    avg_GA     = round(mean(GA), 1),
    avg_GD     = round(mean(GD), 1),
    win_rate   = percent(mean(str_detect(Result, "^W"))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
cat("\n=== Home vs Away summary (2025-26 UCL) ===\n")
## 
## === Home vs Away summary (2025-26 UCL) ===
print(ha_summary)
## # A tibble: 2 × 9
##   Venue matches avg_poss avg_shots avg_sot avg_GF avg_GA avg_GD win_rate
##   <fct>   <int>    <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl> <chr>   
## 1 Home        8     65        18.4     7.5    3.1    1.8    1.4 62%     
## 2 Away        8     60.9      18.8     6.8    2.4    1      1.4 62%
# ---- Plot 1: possession home vs away ----
p_ha_poss <- ha %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Venue, y = Possession, fill = Venue)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Venue), width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Opponent), size = 2.5, color = "grey30",
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Home = psg_blue, Away = psg_red)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Home = psg_blue, Away = psg_red)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Possession: Home vs Away",
       subtitle = "Does PSG hold less of the ball on the road?",
       x = NULL, y = "Possession %") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
print(p_ha_poss)

# ---- Plot 2: shots and goal difference home vs away ----
p_ha_metrics <- ha %>%
  select(Venue, Shots, GD) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Shots, GD), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Metric = recode(Metric, GD = "Goal Difference", Shots = "Shots")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Venue, y = Value, fill = Venue)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Venue), width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Home = psg_blue, Away = psg_red)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Home = psg_blue, Away = psg_red)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Shots & Goal Difference: Home vs Away",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(p_ha_metrics)
